scope: Pinned SAM2-authoritative and SAM3.1-shadow T-shirt video segmentation A/B harness
summary: The harness now prepares one hash-bound frame and initial-mask input, runs SAM2 and SAM3.1 concurrently in isolated environments on distinct physical GPUs, preserves SAM2 as the only decision-bearing evaluator, and reports SAM3.1 agreement diagnostics without reusing incumbent thresholds.
evidence: Ten targeted CPU tests pass for frozen geometry scoring, shadow-policy validation, distinct GPU selection, worker command binding, clean external-source enforcement, shadow-failure isolation, packed-mask comparison, and potential label takeover detection.
Targeted Ruff checks and Ruff format checks pass for all new Python modules and scripts; git diff --check reports no whitespace errors.

The full CPU suite reaches 916 passed and 2 skipped; its only failure is the pre-existing untouched tests/test_joyai_video_edit.py holder-idle-timeout assertion, whose expected argument is absent from origin/main.

The SAM3.1 source is pinned to 8f0b7f4d4e7eda2ed606ebde6702c93359ad01da and the gated facebook/sam3.1 checkpoint is pinned to Hugging Face revision daa63191845a41281374e725f4c9e51c7a824460 with SHA-256 0567debeec80ba4ac6369540c6c248025283cb3ff2b92827509e57e2b3541cb6.
lessons: A shadow evaluator must never gain veto authority over a completed incumbent result; SAM3.1 failure now leaves the SAM2 decision intact and returns an explicit partial outcome.
Checking only a model repository HEAD is insufficient reproducibility evidence; external model repositories must also be clean before their code is imported.
A/B agreement metrics cannot establish accuracy without labeled native-resolution keyframes, so SAM3.1 thresholds and promotion remain intentionally unavailable.
limitations: No real SAM3.1 checkpoint was loaded and no representative T-shirt video was evaluated on NVIDIA hardware in this engineering attempt.
No labeled-keyframe boundary, identity-switch, missed-mask, or wrong-object-takeover comparison exists yet.
The full repository suite retains one unrelated pre-existing JoyAI server timeout test failure.
next_actions: Install the pinned optional environments, run the same representative videos and initial masks on two physical GPUs, and retain every immutable run artifact.
Label native-resolution occlusion and identity-challenge keyframes, compare boundary quality and identity failures, then preregister a separate SAM3.1 evaluator epoch before considering promotion.
